extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology repair; no direct membrane-killing mechanism is promoted from phenotype alone.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper supports phenotype-level biofilm-prevention and biofilm-inhibition effects for LL-37/KE-18/KR-12, with peptide- and assay-specific differences.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Phenotypic biofilm activity is not treated as a direct molecular killing mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The local paper supports LPS/LTA binding context for the peptides, including stronger LTA binding for KE-18 relative to LL-37.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Binding assays support host/pathogen molecule interaction context, not a complete direct antimicrobial mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper supports an in silico amphipathicity/charge/hydrophobicity rationale for selecting KE-18 and KR-12 from LL-37.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Computational structure context is not promoted to direct mechanism evidence.
